comments.text: just realized the girl who ran and jumpscared you at the beginning for a boba tea was the same girl who jumped. she was working overtime and someone theorized that while she was working (already stressed), the power outages deleted all her work which she then had to start over. they also said she ended it that night and wanted the tea shop to be her last moments because she had a connection with it. I’m guessing her spirit is now influencing the shop and even Risa’s mental state, seeing how she referred to the shop as an office. someone else suggested that Risa left corporate to run a tea shop and be free, which didn’t help her mental state due to isolation and stress.

comments.text:
Cory, I know you’re a very busy person and will most likely never even see this comment but I just want you to know what a huge part of our lives as samurai and we are honoured to be a part of your community and how much we appreciate you 🤍 

When I was going through a really hard time in my life getting through a break up, your videos were the only videos I could actually watch as it felt you were the only youtuber showing your true persona and not putting on a fake smile for the camera and you were the only youtuber I felt comfort coming to watch and after having a long day just thinking to myself, I could come watch your videos, and it would take me away from reality and take me into a world of happiness and peace.

I know it may sound silly to have such an “attachment” to a very famous youtuber but you make us feel like we are part of your family, Cory. With the endless jokes, and laughs and feeling in a safe space, you truly are a great person, Cory and have changed many lives for the better just with your videos and helped be there for people you don’t even know by being such an amazing person. 

Thank you Cory, for making us samurai feel like family 🤍
